annotations.title: Add a citation product, or add to one

description: Adds a product for citation checks to track, or adds questions and rivals to one, found by name in any case. Read read-citation-products first, and use suggest-citation-questions for questions to offer the owner. ⚠️ Each question makes every later citation run use more of the owner’s AI credit, so agree the list with the owner. ⛔ It only adds. It cannot remove or replace a product, question or rival, pause a product, start a run, or touch the schedule or keys; the owner does those on the Citations screen. Going past a limit refuses the whole call. Limited to 20 changing calls an hour per connection.

category.description: What kind of thing it is, as a buyer would say it. Sets it when sent; blank leaves it.

domain.description: Its website. Sets it when sent; blank leaves it.

name.description: The product to add, or the one to add to.

name: agentimus-save-citation-product

changed.description: FALSE when it already had all of that.

created.description: TRUE when this made a new product.
